note: Campaign step 55 - episodes 11 and 12. Episode 11 (zirconia surface prep for resin cements) joins #زیرکونیا + #آماده_سازی_سرامیک + #سمان_رزینی (the caption names resin cements as the target). Episode 12 (cleaning contaminated ceramic surfaces) joins the existing #پاکسازی_سرامیک; the page's own spellings 'دی کانتامیناسیون'/'تمیز کردن سرامیک' become aliases. #لمینیت_سرامیکی and #اینله dropped from episode 12: the article resolves decontamination of any ceramic restoration, not laminate- or inlay-specific questions, and the 'اینله' door stays open via the alias on #ترمیم_غیرمستقیم.
